abstract: Malignant transformation of a mature ovarian cystic teratoma is the most serious complication of this relatively common neoplastic lesion. While any constituent tissue of the teratoma can undergo malignant transformation, squamous cell carcinoma represents approximately 80% of those malignancies. Furthermore, the synchronous occurrence of a second malignancy in that setting is extremely rare. Preoperative diagnosis of malignant transformation within a mature cystic teratoma is extremely difficult and poses a great challenge to current clinical surgical practice. The particularly aggressive behavior of this rare tumor, also poses significant surgical managing dilemmas. We present a case report of a premenopausal woman with an invasive squamous cell carcinoma arising in a mature cystic teratoma and a synchronous invasive lobular carcinoma of the breast.
abstract_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化は、この比較的ありふれた腫瘍性病変の最も重篤な合併症である。奇形腫のどの構成組織も悪性転化しうるが、扁平上皮癌がそれらの悪性腫瘍の約80%を占める。さらに、このような状況での第2の悪性腫瘍の同時発生は極めて稀である。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内の悪性転化の術前診断は極めて困難であり、現在の臨床外科診療にとって大きな課題となる。この稀な腫瘍の特に攻撃的な挙動は、外科的管理上も重大なジレンマをもたらす。本稿では、閉経前の女性で卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来の浸潤性扁平上皮癌と、同時性の浸潤性小葉癌を認めた症例を報告する。
